steps.name: $("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[4]/input") set value(Aberforth Dumbledore)
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[4]/input") should have(value="Aberforth Dumbledore")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table/parent::div//button[contains(@class, 'status')]") should not have(text "Status: not pushed")
Проверка успешности создания автомобиля и получение его id
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table/parent::div/div/button[3]") should not be(empty: attribute value="" and exact text "")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table/parent::div//button[contains(@class, 'status')]") should not have(text "Status: not pushed")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table/parent::div//button[contains(@class, 'status')]") should have(match text ".*\d+.*")

$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[3]/input") should have(value="Lesch, Gutkowski and Deckow")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[4]/input") set value(Marge Dursley)
